sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: assigning a non-Copy value transfers ownership, and any later use of the original binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is truly given away no longer belongs to the one who gave it.

sketches.mechanism: Receiving from a closed channel never blocks and yields the element type's zero value on every receive.
sketches.resonance: After an ending, the empty answer can be received forever.
sketches.draft:
package main

func main() {
    ch := make(chan struct{})
    close(ch)
    <-ch
    <-ch
}

sketches.mechanism: An empty inductive type has no constructors, so pattern matching with nomatch is exhaustive because no value can exist.
sketches.resonance: Some absences are so complete that every demand made of them is already answered.
